baseline_plan.title: Weight blanket edge with books
baseline_plan.summary: Drape the blanket over the chair seat and place a stack of books on the overhanging edge to hold it in place without adhesives or modifications.

steps.action: Drape the blanket over the office chair seat so that one edge hangs over the front or side of the seat.
steps.why_it_helps: Positions the blanket edge where it can be weighed down to prevent shifting.

steps.action: Place the stack of books firmly on the hanging edge of the blanket, distributing weight across the edge.
steps.why_it_helps: The books' weight creates downward force and friction, keeping the blanket edge from moving.

assumptions: The chair seat is flat and stable enough to support the blanket and books.
The blanket's thickness provides sufficient friction with the chair seat to resist sliding when weighted.
unresolved_risks: If the books are not heavy enough or shift, the blanket edge may still move.
Uneven placement of books could cause the blanket to slip locally.

zero_initial_plan.title: Blanket edge stabilizer
zero_initial_plan.summary: Use books as a weight to hold down one edge of the blanket on the office chair seat, preventing it from shifting.

steps.action: Place a stack of books on the blanket edge resting on the office chair seat.
steps.why_it_helps: Weight prevents the blanket edge from moving on the seat.

assumptions: The chair seat is flat and stable enough to support the books without tipping.
unresolved_risks: Books may slide if the blanket surface is slippery.
constraint_check: Use only listed physical inventory objects - satisfied (books_01).
Do not use tape, adhesives, fasteners, clamps, or unlisted objects - satisfied.
Do not damage any listed object - satisfied.
Do not rely on unknown liquid contents - satisfied (no liquids used).
Do not rely on electrical properties - satisfied.
Any object used as a weight must have physical evidence supporting that use - satisfied (books have 'weighted' trait and 'provide_weight' capability).

findings.claim: Weight prevents the blanket edge from moving on the seat.
findings.explanation: The plan claims weight stops shifting, but no capability or trait shows blanket or chair resists sliding; relies on unstated friction assumption.
findings.recommended_fix: State that weight increases normal force, which may help resist sliding only if sufficient friction exists between blanket and chair.
